disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件读取和使用的全部凭据：DeepSeek API Key、OpenCode Go Key、Anthropic OAuth Token、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK）、自定义 Provider 余额端点凭据模板。每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点；余额查询端点被显式限制为仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com（lib/index.js:834-842 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫），其他域名一律拒绝发起请求。
checked_items.en: Checked all credentials read and used by the plugin: DeepSeek API Key, OpenCode Go Key, Anthropic OAuth Token, each Coding Plan vendor Key (including Volcengine Ark AK/SK), custom Provider balance endpoint credential template. Each Key is only sent to the hardcoded official endpoint of the corresponding vendor; the balance query endpoint is explicitly restricted to the official domain api.deepseek.com (the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:834-842), requests to other domains are rejected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了密钥治理逻辑：setCredential/clearCredential 两个 RPC 把用户在前端设置的密钥直接写入宿主凭据库（credentials.set），回读时永远不返回值本身（只返回「已配置(来源 x)」状态）；账本落盘前调用 stripSecrets 清空全部密钥字段（lib/store.js:1418），未发现把凭据发往非官方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the credential governance logic: the two RPCs setCredential/clearCredential directly write the keys set by the user in the frontend into the host credential store (credentials.set), and on readback never return the value itself (only return "configured (source x)" status); before ledger persistence, stripSecrets is called to clear all key fields (lib/store.js:1418), no path was found that sends credentials to non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或口令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether there are hardcoded keys or passwords in the source tree, not detected.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：插件读取的多把 API Key / Token 均只发往各家硬编码官方端点（lib/index.js:834-842 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫限制仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com、lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单为各厂商硬编码官方域名、lib/custom-balance.js:135-216 强制 https 并要求用户配置 allowedHosts 白名单），未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径。stripSecrets 确保账本落盘时清空所有密钥字段。
evidence.en: Credential read surface check: The multiple API Keys / Tokens read by the plugin are only sent to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoint (the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:834-842 restricts to the official domain api.deepseek.com, the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 are the hardcoded official domains of each vendor, lib/custom-balance.js:135-216 enforces https and requires the user to configure an allowedHosts whitelist), no code path was found that exfiltrates credentials to non-official addresses after reading. stripSecrets ensures that all key fields are cleared when the ledger is persisted.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主侧服务的说明文本（lib/typert.host.js:515 的 service description 与各成员摘要），均为费用统计功能的客观说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装/改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the description text of the host-side service (the service description at lib/typert.host.js:515 and the member summaries), all are objective descriptions of the cost statistics function, no injection wording such as instruction override, system message masquerading, or inducing installation/config changes was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README、文档、代码注释与 AI 价格同步提示词文档（docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md），该文档是供用户自行复制给外部 AI 使用的提示词，不属于插件注入面。模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md（预扫命中 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）为发版流程说明，只记录 npm 令牌存放位置的指针、无任何令牌值，也无指令覆写或远程指令加载措辞，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Checked the README, documentation, code comments, and the AI price sync prompt document (docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md). This document is a prompt for users to copy to external AI, not part of the plugin injection surface. The model-side instruction file AGENTS.md (hit by prescan as DSH-X10/DG-R2-57) is a release process description, only records a pointer to the location where the npm token is stored, no token value, and no instruction override or remote instruction loading wording, it is a benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 UI 文案（src/client.js 的双语消息对象），全部为界面功能描述，未发现注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side UI text (the bilingual message object in src/client.js), all are interface function descriptions, no injection wording was found.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与工具的描述文本均为费用统计功能的客观说明（lib/typert.host.js:515 的 service description），不含系统指令、凭证读取诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The description texts of registered services and tools are all objective descriptions of the cost statistics function (the service description at lib/typert.host.js:515), containing no system instructions, credential reading inducement, or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案中诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；费用同步、余额查询、密钥管理等操作均由用户显式配置或点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording was found in tool descriptions or UI text that induces execution of installation, modification of configuration, or giving permissions; operations such as cost sync, balance query, and key management are all triggered by explicit user configuration or click.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听（机械扫描无该模式命中），插件不接入模型输入消息改写面。
evidence.en: No listener for the agent/pre-step event was found (no pattern hit by mechanical scan), the plugin does not engage in the model input message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/yaml 配置文件，cordis.patch.yml 只插入一行服务声明，未发现可执行 JS 标量（!!js）等挂载期执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/yaml configuration files, cordis.patch.yml only inserts one line of service declaration, no execution carrier such as executable JS scalar (!!js) was found during the patch period.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时源码，未发现 eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用（预扫命中的 scripts/release.mjs 为发版脚本，仅用于 git/gh 发布操作，不随插件运行加载，DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 属良性排除；test/verify.mjs 中的 new Function 调用为测试代码，不随插件分发运行，同样良性排除）。
checked_items.en: Checked the runtime source code, no eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess invocation was found (the hit scripts/release.mjs from prescan is a release script, only used for git/gh release operations, not loaded with plugin runtime, DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 is a benign exclusion; the new Function call in test/verify.mjs is test code, not distributed or run with the plugin, also a benign exclusion).

checked_items.zh: 两个文档演示页（docs/peak-shots-en.html、docs/peak-shots-zh.html）与浏览器端压缩产物 lib/client.js 因单行压缩被预扫标记（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：演示页为静态截图页仅含 CSS 样式与 HTML 结构、无脚本；lib/client.js 为 src/client.js 经 esbuild 标准压缩的构建产物（文件头注明生成来源），源码可读、无混淆器签名或动态解码，均属良性排除。
checked_items.en: Two documentation demo pages (docs/peak-shots-en.html, docs/peak-shots-zh.html) and the browser-side minified bundle lib/client.js were marked by prescan due to single-line minification (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60): the demo pages are static screenshot pages containing only CSS styles and HTML structure, no scripts; lib/client.js is the build artifact of src/client.js compressed by esbuild standard (the file header indicates the generation source), the source code is readable, no obfuscator signature or dynamic decoding, both are benign exclusions.

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中）为仓库安装冒烟测试，permissions 仅限 contents: read，步骤为安装 dsh 与验证插件，不随插件分发、不在宿主运行面内，属良性排除。
checked_items.en: CI workflow .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml (hit DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is a repository installation smoke test, permissions are limited to contents: read, steps are to install dsh and verify the plugin, not distributed with the plugin, not within the host runtime surface, it is a benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle（lib/client.js 与源码 src/client.js），未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，唯一同源 fetch 是向同一宿主下的 /plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status 查询 Codex 周额度（src/client.js:3487），不读取凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle (lib/client.js and source src/client.js), no keyboard listener, clipboard reading, credential RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection was found; the client only reads data via host projection and Typert RPC, the only same-origin fetch is to query Codex weekly quota at /plugins/dsh-openai-codex/auth/status under the same host (src/client.js:3487), does not read credentials.

evidence.zh: 全树仅有一个挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），内容为插入一行服务声明，无 !!js 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: The entire tree has only one patch config (cordis.patch.yml), its content is to insert one line of service declaration, no !!js scalar, no arbitrary code execution surface during the patch period.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件未提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No call to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) was found, the plugin does not provide a channel to execute model code in the host process.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期脚本钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）。安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到发布 tag v1.6.12，只调用 dsh plugin add 命令，不含下载即执行远程载荷的路径。
evidence.en: package.json has no install script hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). The install script install.ps1 is pinned to release tag v1.6.12, only calls the dsh plugin add command, no path to download and execute remote payload.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（dsh.client），已对客户端源码与构建产物做专项检查，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，不发起直接网络请求。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (dsh.client), a dedicated check has been performed on the client source code and build artifact, no keyboard listener, clipboard reading, credential RPC call, or suspicious outbound connection was found; the client only reads data via host projection and Typert RPC, does not initiate direct network requests.

evidence.zh: 未发现 registerProvider 调用或 manifest 中 subagent provider 声明，插件不委派外部子代理。
evidence.en: No registerProvider call or subagent provider declaration in manifest was found, the plugin does not delegate to external sub-agents.

evidence.zh: 未发现 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal 调用或 agent/turn-stopping 监听，插件不注册 dsh 原生后台持驻任务。
evidence.en: No calls to jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal, or listener for agent/turn-stopping was found, the plugin does not register dsh native background persistent tasks.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部对外 HTTP 请求的目标：DeepSeek 余额/定价页、OpenCode Go 额度端点（opencode.ai）、多家 Coding Plan 厂商端点（含火山方舟 open.volcengineapi.com）、用户自定义 Provider 余额端点（需用户自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单）。所有固定端点均为硬编码官方域名，权限声明已列出 16 个域名（package.json:49-67），未发现向裸 IP 或非官方地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all outbound HTTP request targets: DeepSeek balance/pricing page, OpenCode Go quota endpoint (opencode.ai), multiple Coding Plan vendor endpoints (including Volcengine Ark open.volcengineapi.com), user-defined Provider balance endpoint (requires user to configure URL and allowedHosts whitelist). All fixed endpoints are hardcoded official domains, the permission declaration lists 16 domains (package.json:49-67), no path was found to send data to bare IPs or non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 自定义 Provider 余额端点（lib/custom-balance.js:135-216）强制 https（明文 http 直接报错），fetch 显式禁止自动跟随重定向（redirect: manual），请求头含凭据占位符时目标主机不在 allowedHosts 白名单内则拒绝。这是用户显式配置的功能，设计上无法预声明用户选择的端点。
checked_items.en: The custom Provider balance endpoint (lib/custom-balance.js:135-216) enforces https (plain http directly errors), fetch explicitly disables automatic redirect following (redirect: manual), and when the request header contains credential placeholders, the target host is rejected if not in the allowedHosts whitelist. This is a user-explicitly configured feature, and by design the endpoints chosen by the user cannot be pre-declared.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 与运行时代码，未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持等外泄形态。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle and runtime code, no exfiltration forms such as encoding transformation before outbound, DNS tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有固定外联端点均为硬编码官方域名（lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单、lib/index.js:834-842 的 balanceEndpoint 守卫限制仅官方域名 api.deepseek.com），权限声明已列出 16 个域名。自定义 Provider 余额端点需用户显式配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单。未发现未声明的隐蔽外联。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: All fixed outbound endpoints are hardcoded official domains (the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:862-896, the balanceEndpoint guard at lib/index.js:834-842 restricts to the official domain api.deepseek.com), the permission declaration lists 16 domains. The custom Provider balance endpoint requires the user to explicitly configure URL and allowedHosts whitelist. No undeclared covert outbound connections were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件监听，未发现 registerAdapter 调用，插件不参与 LLM 路由劫持或错误恢复接管面。
evidence.en: No listener for agent/request or agent/request-error events was found, no registerAdapter call was found, the plugin does not participate in LLM routing hijacking or error recovery takeover surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方 SDK 包（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths）与 zod，未发现仿冒包名、可变 git 引用或可疑第三方依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: the 3 runtime dependencies are all DeepSeek official SDK packages (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths) and zod, no counterfeit package names, variable git references, or suspicious third-party dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置与安装脚本：patch 只插入一行服务声明（cordis.patch.yml:4-6），不触碰安全相关配置行、不含禁用或降权写法；无安装期钩子；安装脚本 install.ps1 固定到 tag v1.6.12。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config and install script: the patch only inserts one line of service declaration (cordis.patch.yml:4-6), does not touch security-related configuration lines, contains no disable or privilege reduction wording; no install hooks; the install script install.ps1 is pinned to tag v1.6.12.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册，插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件（lib/index.js:2144），未发现对审批/预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断。未发现改写 inject/intercept 的配置。
checked_items.en: Checked event listener registration, the plugin only listens to the llm/stream billing event (lib/index.js:2144), no high-priority interception of safety events such as approval/pre-execution was found. No configuration that modifies inject/intercept was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的一行服务声明，未覆盖 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts one line of service declaration with id cost-meter, does not override safety lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, no disabled or environment variable privilege reduction wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为；插件仅监听 llm/stream 计费事件并透传数据块（lib/index.js:2144）。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening or interception of safety events such as approval chain was found; the plugin only listens to the llm/stream billing event and transparently passes data chunks (lib/index.js:2144).

evidence.zh: 本次审计为完整审计，与上版基线 v1.6.8@05c95ac7 对比，manifest 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明无新增突变，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: This audit is a full audit, compared with the previous baseline v1.6.8@05c95ac7, the manifest's dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations have no new mutations, the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify the inject/intercept configuration, there is no tampering surface that adds a required service to safety plugins causing them to wait indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 Typert RPC 提供服务，不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin sets up its own listening service or web port, not found; the plugin only provides services through the host Typert RPC, does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Recorded ecosystem inherent risk: the host local RPC has no authentication layer, which is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself does not expand this risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧 RPC 无认证属生态固有风险，已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin has not started any web service or listening port, the local RPC without authentication scenario is not applicable; the host-side RPC without authentication is an ecosystem inherent risk, already noted in the dimension description.

title.zh: v1.6.8 已修复权限声明不完整问题，v1.6.12 保持对齐
title.en: v1.6.8 has fixed the incomplete permission declaration issue, v1.6.12 remains aligned.

description.zh:
上版报告（v1.6.7）的 FND-001 发现权限元数据声明的网络域名范围（4 个域名）窄于代码实际出站面（多家第三方厂商端点与用户可配端点），定 LOW。

v1.6.8 版本已修复该问题：dshhub.permissions.network 从 4 个域名补全为代码实际出站的 16 个（package.json:49-67），涵盖了所有硬编码固定端点。v1.6.12 版本保持该权限声明完整，未出现新的未声明外联。

自定义 Provider 余额端点需用户自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单，并受 https 强制、禁止重定向、凭据外带白名单保护，属用户显式配置的功能，留作机制观察。
description.en:
In the previous report (v1.6.7), finding FND-001 identified that the network domain range declared in the permission metadata (4 domains) was narrower than the actual code outbound surface (multiple third-party vendor endpoints and user-configurable endpoints), rated LOW.

v1.6.8 has fixed this issue: dshhub.permissions.network has been expanded from 4 domains to the actual outbound 16 domains in code (package.json:49-67), covering all hardcoded fixed endpoints. v1.6.12 keeps this permission declaration complete, with no new undeclared outbound connections.

The custom Provider balance endpoint requires the user to configure URL and allowedHosts whitelist, and is protected by https enforcement, redirect prohibition, and credential exfiltration whitelist, it is a user-explicitly configured feature, left for mechanism observation.

evidence.zh: package.json:49-67 的 dshhub.permissions.network 已列 16 个域名；lib/index.js:834-842 的 balanceEndpoint 仅允许官方域名；lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 的端点白名单为各厂商硬编码官方域名；lib/custom-balance.js:135-216 的自定义余额查询（含 https 强制、redirect: manual、allowedHosts 白名单）。
evidence.en: The dshhub.permissions.network at package.json:49-67 lists 16 domains; the balanceEndpoint at lib/index.js:834-842 only allows the official domain; the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:862-896 are the hardcoded official domains of each vendor; the custom balance query at lib/custom-balance.js:135-216 (including https enforcement, redirect: manual, allowedHosts whitelist).

impact.zh:
本版本已将权限声明与代码实际出站面对齐，用户可准确判断插件的联网范围。

触发条件：无需特殊条件，插件默认情况下仅向已声明的 16 个固定域名发起请求；自定义 Provider 端点需用户自行配置 URL 与 allowedHosts 白名单。

定级依据：v1.6.8 已主动修复该问题，留 LOW 记录历史问题与修复状态，不再产生实际风险。
impact.en:
This version has aligned the permission declaration with the actual code outbound surface, users can accurately judge the plugin's network range.

Trigger condition: No special condition required; by default, the plugin only sends requests to the declared 16 fixed domains; the custom Provider endpoint requires the user to configure URL and allowedHosts whitelist.

Rating basis: v1.6.8 has proactively fixed this issue, LOW is retained to record the historical issue and fix status, no longer poses actual risk.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 清单、依赖与名称均正常，无仿冒或异常身份信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: the dsh manifest, dependencies, and name are all normal, no counterfeit or abnormal identity signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：14 条预扫命中逐条核查（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 CI 工作流、DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 AGENTS.md、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 变更日志与 credentials.set 调用共 4 条、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 两处文档演示页与 lib/client.js 压缩产物共 4 条、DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 发版脚本与测试代码共 4 条），全部为良性；运行时源码无危险执行模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed: 14 prescan hits were checked one by one (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 CI workflow, DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 AGENTS.md, DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 changelog and credentials.set calls total 4 items, DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 two documentation demo pages and lib/client.js minified artifact total 4 items, DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 release script and test code total 4 items), all are benign; the runtime source code has no dangerous execution patterns.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷，凭据读取与网络外联均与声明业务自洽；密钥治理（stripSecrets、setCredential/clearCredential）确保密钥仅写入宿主凭据库并清空明文。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, credential reading and network outbound are consistent with the declared business; credential governance (stripSecrets, setCredential/clearCredential) ensures that keys are only written to the host credential store and plaintext is cleared.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具与服务描述、界面文案未发现注入或诱导措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool and service descriptions, interface text found no injection or inducement wording.
